# Code-conditioned return experiments: paid preparation removes dilution, not complexity

Root conditional physical/interface construction, 2026-11-01. This note does not claim a laboratory implementation, logical-gate advantage, or independently reviewed multiseed extension.

## Actual scalar experiment

Let P be an actual code projector of rank d_C, and F_i Hermitian logical Pauli operators supported on that code, F_i²=P, with physical operator norm1. Normalize the full physical Hilbert-Schmidt inner product by <A,B>=Tr(A B)/d_C. Then ||F_i||=1 even though the code is a small fraction of the physical Hilbert space.

For a traceless F_i, suppose the experiment can actually prepare the two normalized logical eigensembles rho_±=(P±F_i)/d_C. Choose s=±1 uniformly, prepare rho_s, execute the desired operation, and measure a final logical Pauli F_j, assigning value0 to code-space failure. The signed report s*o lies in[-1,1] and has mean

 E[s o]=Tr[F_j T(F_i)]/d_C.

For F_i=P, simply prepare P/d_C and use s=+1. A report0 may be converted to an unbiased binary report by an independent fair coin; this is paid randomization, not conditioning on successful outcomes.

This avoids the O(d_C/d_physical) dilution of a whole-register infinite-temperature trace by CHANGING AND PAYING preparation. It does not infer code-conditioned performance from the old maxmixed signal. Encoding, ancilla initialization, mixture generation, final code/logical measurement, calibration, discarded attempts and systematic preparation/readout bias remain costs. If these cannot be supplied to the required bias accuracy, this source is not earned.

## Actual adjoints without reversing dissipation

Suppose each selected measurement operation has a CP map T_a(X)=sum_r K_(a,r) X K_(a,r), with every K_(a,r) Hermitian and sum_r K_(a,r)²<=I. Such a map is self-adjoint in the normalized Hilbert-Schmidt inner product and is a contraction there: the standard Schwarz inequality for subunital CP maps gives ||T_a X||_2²<=Tr T_a(X*X)<=Tr X*X. The trace inequality uses the same sum K²<=I. For a single projector or positive weak-measurement branch this is immediate.

# Hermitian-measurement spin interface: source earned conditionally; consequential-task gate still open

Root-selected interface assessment, 2026-11-01. No hardware actions. Verdict: unlike Gibbs mixing or dissipative time reversal, this candidate can honestly supply the stipulated scalar experiment using explicit preparation resources. Its easiest low-rank regime is exactly trivial for an ordinary learner. A genuinely consequential measurement-control task exists in the literature, but the present single infinite-temperature Pauli-return task does not certify that task, and its low dimension is not established.

## 1. Primitive and actual adjoint

On n qubits, D=2^n, assume each primitive has a FIXED generator

ℒ_a(X)=−(1/2)Σ_j [L_aj,[L_aj,X]], L_aj=L_aj†,
Φ_a=exp(t_a ℒ_a).

Use real Hermitian operator space and <X,Y>=Tr(XY)/D. Direct integration by parts gives ℒ_a†=ℒ_a and <X,ℒ_a X>=−(1/2D)Σ_j ||[L_aj,X]||²_HS≤0. Hence Φ_a is unital CPTP, self-adjoint and a contraction. The adjoint is the SAME physical primitive; no negative dissipation or inverse pulse is requested.

Purely Hermitian-jump Markovian dynamics is a physical premise, not a deduction from fitting returns. Coherent Hamiltonian drift, relaxation, leakage, asymmetric feedback, environment memory and uncalibrated ancillary gates can violate it. A time-varying succession of noncommuting measurement generators is NOT generally a self-adjoint primitive: expose its fixed blocks as separate labels and reverse their order for its adjoint. A construction using basis-change gates around a measurement must pay those gates and prove the complete noisy block has the advertised adjoint; ideal conjugation notation is insufficient.

## 2. Paid infinite-temperature preparation and measurement backaction

A route not requiring a cold pure reset is an independently randomized FULL local Pauli twirl. For arbitrary initial joint state ρ_SE, the ideal system-only twirl satisfies

4^(−n) Σ_{P∈{I,X,Y,Z}^⊗n} (P⊗I)ρ_SE(P†⊗I)=(I/D)⊗Tr_S ρ_SE.

It therefore both prepares the maximally mixed system and removes initial system–environment correlations in the averaged episode. It costs 2n fresh random bits and O(n) ideal local Pauli choices, with all physical pulse time, energy, error and control infrastructure paid.
